text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the tremors in your hands, specifically when they occur and if you have noticed any changes in your mood or sleep?

His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Has the tremor persisted when your hand is completely at rest, or does it mainly happen when you are trying to hold a position or perform an action?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see, so you are experiencing a resting tremor that is worse on the left side, along with soft speech and reduced facial expressions. To help narrow this down, have you noticed any stiffness in your limbs or a slowing of your physical movements?

text: Past medical history: Hypertension, medicated with aspirin and amlodipine. Family history of schizophrenia in his mother. No other significant medical or psychiatric history. Social history: Drinks 1-2 beers nightly and is a former cigar smoker.

speaker: Doctor
